english.note: Use 挑釁 as the all-purpose noun for a deliberate provocative or hostile act, including one intended to draw a reaction.

examples.english: Their provocation of the opponent nearly started a fight.
examples.traditional: 佢喺球場上面向對手挑釁，搞到大家差啲打起上嚟。
